record.design: American Cancer Society statistics report from registries and death data
record.finding: In 2023 about 153,020 people in the US would be diagnosed and 52,550 would die; incidence is rising 1-2% a year in people under 55, and 60% of new cases were advanced in 2019. The abstract names mortality rising in Native Americans, not Black people, and gives no Black-specific rate.
record.note: Opened for Black-specific figures and found none in the abstract; the full report was not read.
